pages.text: Surround one soul sand or soul soil with eight slimeballs in a crafting table.
Use the item on a block or water source to summon a companion tamed to you. Survival consumes it. A newly crafted item can be reused in Creative. An anvil name becomes its name.

Craft a $(l:basics/tuner)Slime Tuner$() to manage it. Every new companion starts in Wait. Choose Follow or a profession command before expecting movement or work. An Attention Slime can replace the Friendly base in basic specialization recipes; upgrades remain and Attention traits end.
